# Mono–Poly and the Two Ones — Transverse Thread

This path preserves the ontological kernel across the essay without turning it into a parallel topic. It begins only after zero and one have been earned, carries their formal differentiation through the two logics and the eight determinations, and lands politically and technically where shared relation must coordinate real plurality without claiming to have manufactured trust.

1. [[15-s1-p2-empty-set-generates-one|§1 · #2 — The Empty Set Generates One]] gives the numerical floor: `0 = ∅`, `1 = {0}`, and `2 = {0,1}`; whole-number and natural-number firstness divide the two ones without reducing QL `0` to a set-theoretic object.
2. [[17-s1-p4-zero-outside-math|§1 · #4 — Zero Keeps One Foot Outside Mathematics]] exposes the return-edge at which the marked one cannot make its condition into ordinary content.
3. [[18-s1-p5-loan-returns|§1 · #5→0 — The Loan Returns]] earns `0/1 = 1/0` as the root symbolon in QL's relational register and introduces Mono/One and Poly/All in their exact asymmetry.
4. [[19-s2-p0-difference-cannot-be-escaped|§2 · #0 — Difference Cannot Be Escaped]], [[20-s2-p1-dia-ballein|§2 · #1 — Dia-Ballein]], and [[21-s2-p2-sym-ballein|§2 · #2 — Sym-Ballein]] distinguish the primordial relation from the two ways polarity is accounted: signed displacement and seam-retaining return.
5. [[22-s2-p3-ares-aphrodite-harmonia|§2 · #3 — Ares, Aphrodite, Harmonia, Eros, and Hephaestus]] gives the relation a mythemic body. Hephaestus’s bonds capture the lovers and make the affair publicly visible. Spectators respond differently, and the demand for recompense becomes a dispute about its payment. Poseidon’s contingent liability, accepted by Hephaestus, makes release possible. The successful apparatus borrows an undertaking it cannot manufacture by tightening its bonds. Hesiod’s Harmonia genealogy gives productive concord its separate telling; it is not a birth episode in Homer’s capture song.
6. [[24-s2-p5-zero-changes-role|§2 · #5→0 — Zero Changes Its Role]] derives `2 + 2² = 4+2`; QL emerges from the two ones rather than receiving mono–poly as a later application.
7. [[25-s3-p0-eight-determinations|§3 · #0 — Eight Determinations]] and [[26-s3-p1-spanda-4-2|§3 · #1 — The Spanda Equations and 4+2]] carry the relation through `X/x`, `∞/dx`, and the sixfold body.
8. [[32-s4-p1-jung-individuation|§4 · #1 — Individuation through the QL `X/x`]] and [[33-s4-p2-complexio-quaternity-senarius|§4 · #2 — Complexio, Quaternity, and Senarius]] provide psychic refraction and recall the mythic relation without detaching it from its source.
9. [[38-s5-p1-apoha-softmax|§5 · #1 — Actuation: Living Articulation]] carries preference and the occupied zero within its model/evaluator inquiry. A selected output inherits a comparison field, source, criterion and permission. A contrary encounter can correct the result, task or model under a fitting rule; a failed rule or permission must reach the office capable of revising it. A fitting condition can be retained with reasons. These returns differ in depth, and a claim of changed processing needs the identified change and the later act that inherited it. The source and authority of the criterion remain answerable even when that criterion is retained.
10. [[44-s50-p1-ql-mef-bimba-harness|§5→0 · #1 — QL, MEF, Bimba, and Harness]], [[46-s50-p3-4-2-mono-poly|§5→0 · #3 — 4:2 Technē and the Sovereign Commons]], and [[48-s50-p5-ahi-planetary-return|§5→0 · #5→0 — AHI and Planetary Return]] develop shared grammar, the sovereign commons and planetary return through relations among distinct participants. What returns must remain attributable and available to the next act as a warranted correction or reasoned retention; the participants retain their own grounds and powers of response within the shared field.

[[symbolon/episteme/maps/trust-faith-formal-limit|Trust, Faith, and the Formal Limit — Transverse Thread]] runs alongside this path. Trust enters as the lived relation beneath knowledge and remains distinct from the whole/many topology that can protect or capture its conditions.
